beats.headline: Glurp, glurp
beats.text: Two crawlers, Li Jun and Zhang, a pack of Brindled Vespas, and me with the microphone. That is the format. The format works, and I am very, very good at it. Then the one with the cat opens his mouth. He wagers, on my air, that the production will not dare touch him, and the production, to my everlasting disgust, does not. He walks the whole group off my show alive. Every one of them. Glurp, glurp. We will be right back.

beats.headline: Of gods and royalty
beats.text: Off mic, the barefoot one asks if I was ever a crawler. Please. I come from a civilized system. My family was there when the Syndicate created the crawl. We are of gods and royalty. The Blood Sultanate? Do I look like a Naga? My family's Skull Clan has won six of the last ten, top three every time, and the Sultanate is almost always the first of the nine eliminated. They have been dead, the pair of them, since the cat put on that crown. I am on my way to their planet right now, and on the ninth floor I will be War Leader Maestro.

beats.headline: The show goes on hiatus
beats.text: My show is on hiatus while it restructures. A spokesperson for the royal family has requested that people stop calling me Carl's Naughty Little Piggie. So far nobody is complying. Odette tells her audience never to call me that, holds out her hands, and they shout it for her. The crawler sits on her couch, says he knows nothing about the video, and says his offer of single combat still stands. Then her audience starts glurping.

beats.headline: Disowned, then rumoured aboard
beats.text: The Maestro has been stripped of his titles and disowned by his father, amid unrest in the Skull Empire's home systems, and is no longer counted as royalty. When Prince Stalwart's yacht fires on the wrong trailer, the Valtay Corporation claims one of its dreadnoughts in Earth orbit has destroyed that yacht. Stalwart was not aboard. The Queen Consort Ugloo and the former prince are rumoured to have been. Princess Donut asks Carl whether he heard that the Maestro is dead. He did.

beats.headline: Back, in a god
beats.text: People thought I was on that ship. My brother had already brought me into the dungeon; like I'd be stupid enough to be vulnerable like that. You gotta try harder, worms. Rest well, Mom. Now I'm Grull, level 250 and invulnerable, and I have a dozen ways to kill the piglet. I want to pick him up and crush him in my hand. His planet was nothing, and nobody is going to remember it. There he is, on a derailed train by the gate, flipping me off. Here, piglet, piglet.

beats.headline: Ejected into the steel
beats.text: Glurp, glurp. I am riding a god of war through a factory, I have finally found the man with the cat, and I am in the middle of a sentence, a very good sentence, when the cat casts Laundry Day and I am out of Grull's chest and dropping into a river of molten steel. It is fine. It is television. Nothing kills a tourist on this floor. I will be splattered, I will regenerate, and the soul armor rule sends me straight back to my god. A few minutes. They may have a few minutes.
